title: End-of-support orchestration for legacy model checkpoints with in-line migration hints
creator: Avery Chandra
description: Goal: Build an orchestrated end-of-support (EoS) workflow for model checkpoints that combines automated user-facing notices, SDK/server-side pin suggestions, performance-profile-aware migration hints, and archival operations. This ticket implements the engineering glue: notification pipeline, telemetry signals, API warning headers, pin-suggester service, and automated archival triggers for models that cross the EoS window. We will prioritize minimal disruption to customers who have pinned versions while giving actionable migration guidance tied to published performance profiles.
acceptance_criteria: API returns 'x-model-support' header with support window and suggested migration version for any request hitting a soon-to-be-EoS model
Console shows per-model 'end-of-support' banner with one-click 'Create Migration Plan' that pre-populates target model, expected latency/cost delta, and required SDK changes
Pin-suggester microservice emits recommendations based on model compatibility table and performance profiles and is used by the SDK warning flow
Telemetry emits a stable EoS signal (eos_notice_sent, eos_pin_update_attempt, eos_migration_started) ingested into the console dashboard
Automated archival job moves model weights to cold storage after the final EoS date and records archival artifact in audit logs
Rollback procedure validated: if migration causes regression, traffic can be routed back to pinned model variant for 72 hours via runtime fallback policy
notes: We intentionally call this 'end-of-support' not 'deprecation' to reduce customer alarm. UX/PM alignment complete.
Performance-profile mapping will be driven from the existing profile catalog; need one-off transforms for older checkpoint metadata.
We will stagger notices: 90d, 30d, 7d pre-EoS and a final 'end-of-support' day-of notice.
Legal has asked for audit trail retention of all notices for 2 years; storage cost considerations noted.
Estimate assumes pin-suggester uses current compatibility heuristics and does not require new model evaluations (follow-up ticket if QA evals needed).
